messages.subject: [RESULT][VOTE] Airflow Providers - release preparation date 2026-10-14
messages.body:
Hello,

Apache Airflow Providers prepared on 2026-10-14 have been accepted.

4 "+1" binding votes received:
- Jarek Potiuk
- Vincent Beck
- Shahar Epstein
- Kaxil Naik

1 "+1" non-binding vote received:
- David Blain

1 "+1" non-binding vote received for specific providers:
- Aaron Chen (amazon)

The common.ai provider has been excluded from the release.
Kaxil found that its "skills" extra allows pydantic-ai-skills 2.x,
which breaks a fresh "[skills]" install at run time. The fix (#74899)
is merged, and common.ai 1.0.0rc2 with the fix will be released as an
ad-hoc release on its own with an accelerated vote period.

The released providers are: amazon, common.compat, dbt.cloud and google.

Vote thread: https://lists.apache.org/thread/s2qht3onyscf3wtl67bv7g09p605yzwl

I'll continue with the release process, and the release announcement
will follow shortly.

Cheers,
Jarek Potiuk
